AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description:
Wuthering Waves graphics configuration generator and log analyser. Produces proposed engine configuration text, and diagnostics about the device GPU, memory, frame rate and stability.
Operational Patterns: - 'generateConfig' covers most requests alone: it picks the preset and applies every generator option in one call. - For a vague optimisation request, pair 'recommendPreset' with 'listPresets' rather than guessing a preset name. 'recommendPreset' returns a preset identifier, and 'listPresets' explains what each one trades away. - 'analyzeGameLog' analyses a log the user supplies. It is the only function that needs input from the user, and the only one that reports frame drops, thermal events and GPU out-of-memory counts. - 'getDeployHistory' is the only record of whether a configuration actually improved frame rate; prefer it over inferring an outcome from 'getCachedLogAnalysis'.
Constraints: - No function writes to the game or to device storage. Configuration is returned as text for the user to review. - 'analyzeGameLog' analyses only a log the user provides; this app holds no device connection and cannot read the game's own log on demand. - 'getCachedLogAnalysis' and 'getCachedBattleStats' return empty when no analysis has been run, or when the cache is older than 24 hours. - Generated configuration text is long. Request it once and quote from the result rather than calling 'generateConfig' repeatedly for comparison.
